lanes.claim: A query naming what a person wants to do reaches the entity kinds that afford it, through a reviewed phrase vocabulary whose every surface form points at a committed record, and without the vocabulary claiming a phrase the category or name lexicons already answer.
lanes.landed: PR #1977 replaced the ten-entry experiment table with `@mailwoman/activity-lexicon` — 11 reviewed entries, 4 attestation classes, 2 locale-scoped — and committed the phrase-collision census. PR #1979 made the two existing scopes (per-entry locales and `RelationAssertion.countries`) actually reachable inside the phrase search.

lanes.claim: The compiled artifact carries the wave-1 semantics the §4.1 amendment admits, and a phrase whose activity is afforded by more than one mapped kind reaches every one of them rather than whichever concept sorts first by code point.
lanes.landed: PR #1981 authored W1-1 (the `drugstore` concept) and W1-2 (its US-scoped `affords` assertion) into model 0.2.0 with full provenance, re-ran the recall census against the shipped `poi.db`, corrected the relation-semantics note, and committed board row `sem-act-us-03` as an `improvement_target`.
lanes.blockedReason: W1-3, the `poi-taxonomy` mapping the amendment also admits, is deliberately held. With it the one activity `obtain_medication` reaches two mapped kinds, and the merged §8.1 interim rule refuses such a phrase at construction — measured on PR #1981's branch, all eleven declared phrases refuse, the route becomes unbuildable and the recognition capability goes from 3/4 to 0/4. #1980 widens `matchPOISubject` and `POIIntent.evidence` to carry a set so the union can be searched and the resolver's existing ordering can rank it; W1-3 is authored behind it. Until then the lane's operational half cannot be measured at all, and a number reported for it would describe a route that is not the one this phase would ship.

plannedChecks.measures: Board row `sem-act-us-03` (`where can i pick up a prescription near Coalinga CA`) answers `pharmacy`-or-`drugstore` within 25 km and is promoted from `improvement_target` to a COUNTED `pass`.
plannedChecks.todayReads: Tracked and failing as registered: `expected a poi outcome (results), got path=full (no poi intent)`. At that anchor `pharmacy near Coalinga CA` returns zero rows while `drugstore near Coalinga CA` returns two, at 0.77 km and 1.71 km.

plannedChecks.measures: `conceptsForExternalID("poi-taxonomy", "drugstore")` answers the `drugstore` concept on the committed artifact — W1-3 authored.
plannedChecks.todayReads: `[]`. The identifier is read back in `pharmacy-slice.test.ts` so the held mapping cannot rot into a dead reference; `getPOICategory("drugstore")` answers `{ id: "drugstore", hierarchy: ["retail", "drugstore"] }`.

plannedChecks.measures: All 11 declared phrases build with W1-3 present — the §8.1 plural-affordance construction refusal is lifted because the query surface carries a set.
plannedChecks.todayReads: Every one of the 11 refuses when the mapping is added, with the refusal naming the phrase and both kinds. Pinned by a test that adds the held-out mapping and asserts the refusal.

plannedChecks.measures: US drugstore recall: the 6,679 US rows under `retail > drugstore` become reachable from a query the shipped `pharmacy` branch answers.
plannedChecks.todayReads: Out of reach by construction — the two Overture leaves are disjoint and `pharmacy` declares no `overtureCategories`. Re-measured on `poi.db` `2026-07-22.0`: 7,168 of 89,336 rows under the two leaves (8.0%) overall, 6,679 of 51,624 (12.9%) within the US.

lanes.claim: Where the compiled artifact asserts that the answered category affords an activity AND the coverage layer surveyed the searched cell and holds nothing there, the answer carries a coverage-qualified absence observation. Everywhere else the route is silent.
lanes.landed: PR #1976 shipped the negative-evidence route against the #1964 pilot layer, with both provenances on every observation line and three refusals that would otherwise have presented as a route that simply never fires.

lanes.claim: Both observation routes live in the runtime tree as a supported opt-in surface, an observation reaches a caller as a `QueryIntentMarker`, and with no route handed in the default path is what shipped — floors, laws and composition unmoved.
lanes.landed: PR #1979 moved both routes to `mailwoman/observations`, added the marker carrier, implemented the §8.1 interim refusal in both code-point orders, made the two scopes reachable, moved `@mailwoman/geographic-model` to a real dependency, and re-pointed the three promoted board rows at #1967.
